scope: Every CARDS key, native audio formats, actual engine release/contact events, spell casts, abilities/deaths/status events, loaded and empty-buffer states, mute and burst scheduling.
limits: The output-envelope harness instruments the real SoundSystem methods; it does not render the browser compressor or prove perceived loudness.
Silent DOT ticks are reported separately from missing one-shot cues; playing a sound for every damaged body is not recommended.

stress.note: Gain sum is an upper-bound scheduling indicator, not measured waveform clipping.
